# device42_customer_contact (Resource)


## Exemple 

```hcl
resource "device42_customer_contact" "johnDoe" {
    customer = "acmeCorp"
    name     = "John Doe"
    type     = "primary"
    email    = "john.doe@acme.com"
    phone    = "+1 555 000 000"
    address  = "100 Main Street, New York"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer` (String) Name of the parent customer.
- `name` (String) Name of the contact.
- `type` (String) Type of the contact.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the contact.
- `email` (String) Email of the contact.
- `phone` (String) Phone of the contact.

### Read-Only

- `contact_id` (Number) ID of the contact.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

### Import

Import is supported using the parent customer name and the contact name, e.g.

```bash
$ terraform import device42_customer_contact.johnDoe acmeCorp/John Doe
```
